title: The regions discover read, one row each

status.description: ok: the list was read to its end; forbidden: the credential may not list Lambda functions there (an SCP, a missing permission); failed: any other error, with a matching entry in the run's errors

functions.description: Lambda functions in the region (0 for a region that was read and is empty); null when the region could not be read

omitted.description: Regions left out of items by maxItems
